title: Finishing Strong Requires Capturing Your Thoughts
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the tactics of the enemy to conform us to the world's way of thinking and shows us how to resist and overcome these attacks through the renewing of our minds and the authority of Christ Jesus. You'll learn how to identify and cast out the "fiery darts of the wicked" that try to steal your peace and distract you from your purpose. Join Pastor Zehner as he equips you to be a warrior of the faith and take every thought captive in the name of Jesus.
